training_scope: Previously frozen measured compiler costs, used only as advisory model inputs; not current runtime performance samples or publication credentials
holdout_scope: New complete controller traces; timing never feeds the frozen cost model or changes trace selection
arm_order: Rotate by group plus trace index; reverse on odd groups
sample_exclusion: none; failed, refused and timed-out attempts remain in the result
cache_reset: All reuse owners start empty for every arm and trace group
control_fairness: Fixed, complete DP and exhaustive controls receive identical inputs, full future graph, identical reuse capacity and exact identity invalidation; they need not serialize native protocol events
fixed_plan_scope: Commit the minimum-cost complete plan for an exact input; recompute on any changed input identity
cost_scope: Outer episode wall time, including construction, native admission, cache population and checks, selection, response validation, per-call evidence encoding/write and close
common_cost: One measured input/source/protocol preparation charge per standalone strategy, never shared across its competitors
cold_cost: Charge the recorded original empty-target native bridge build once to each standalone native strategy; report warm and cold separately
